'''Crunchcane Plot''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|To use this plot, follow the steps of fine cultivation and harvest the ripened crops to get plenty of Crunchcanes.|A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Crunchcanes.
